title: Who Can Stand Before You?

questions.question: In Judah God is known; his name is great in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:1 (ESV): "In Judah God is known; his name is great in Israel."

questions.question: His abode has been established in Salem, his dwelling place in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:2 (ESV): "His abode has been established in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion."

questions.question: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shield, the sword, and the weapons of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:3 (ESV): "...the shield, the sword, and the weapons of war."

questions.question: Glorious are you, more majestic than the mountains full of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:4 (ESV): "Glorious are you, more majestic than the mountains full of prey."

questions.question: The stouthearted were stripped of their spoil; they sank into what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:5 (ESV): "The stouthearted were stripped of their spoil; they sank into sleep;"

questions.question: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse lay how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:6 (ESV): "...both rider and horse lay stunned."

questions.question: But you, you are to be feared! Who can stand before you when once your what is roused?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:7 (ESV): "...when once your anger is roused?"

questions.question: From heaven you uttered judgment; the earth feared and was what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:8 (ESV): "From heaven you uttered judgment; the earth feared and was still,"

questions.question: When God arose to establish judgment, to save all the humble of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:9 (ESV): "...to save all the humble of the earth."

questions.question: Surely the wrath of man shall praise you; the remnant of wrath you will put on like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:10 (ESV): "...the remnant of wrath you will put on like a belt."

questions.question: Make your vows to the Lord your God and perform them; let all around him bring what to him who is to be feared?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:11 (ESV): "...let all around him bring gifts to him who is to be feared,"

questions.question: Who cuts off the spirit of princes?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:12 (ESV): "who cuts off the spirit of princes,"

questions.question: Who is terrible to the kings of the earth?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:12 (ESV): "who is terrible to the kings of the earth."

questions.question: This Psalm is a Song of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76 Title: "...A Psalm of Asaph. A Song."

questions.question: None of the men of war were able to use their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 76:5 (ESV): "...none of the men of war were able to use their hands."

key_verse_text: But you, you are to be feared! Who can stand before you when once your anger is roused?
